Safety

Fast when it matters. Quiet when it doesn’t.

SOS alerts, responses, Safety Activity and Lock Screen updates are built around getting useful information to the right people without making the whole app feel like an alarm panel.

Check-In

A simple way to say “I made it.”

Set a Check-In, get reminded when it’s due and let the people who care know you’ve arrived safely. Small feature, surprisingly useful.

Neighbourhood is free to use.

If you like what we’re building, optional support helps cover hosting, notifications and ongoing development. No features are locked behind a donation.

Support Neighbourhood

Neighbourhood is not emergency response.

SOS helps alert nearby users, but it does not contact or replace emergency services. In an emergency, call 000 in Australia or your local emergency number.
